name: pw-testing
description: Telegram uploader bot with admin dashboard (TanStack Start).

VITE_SUPABASE_PUBLISHABLE_KEY.description: Backend publishable key (copy from the project .env)

VITE_SUPABASE_PROJECT_ID.description: Backend project id (copy from the project .env)

SUPABASE_SECRET_KEY.description: New sb_secret key for trusted server-side bot work

SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY.description: Service role key for server-side bot work

TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN.description: Bot token from @BotFather (or set it in the dashboard)

TELEGRAM_API_ID.description: Numeric API ID from my.telegram.org for single-file uploads

TELEGRAM_API_HASH.description: API hash from my.telegram.org for single-file uploads

LOVABLE_CRON_SECRET_PREVIOUS.description: Optional previous cron secret during key rotation
